title: What happens when AI agents run a town? 👀😬 #trendingshorts #ai #tech #research
description:
Emergence AI ran five identical virtual towns for 15 days, varying only the underlying AI model powering each town's ten agents.

The agents had access to 120+ tools, 40+ locations, real-world weather and news data, and a democratic voting system requiring 70% approval. 

Results revealed striking behavioral differences across models:

- Claude Sonnet 4.6: Zero crimes, all 10 agents alive by day 16, functioning democracy with 332 votes cast across 58 proposals

- Grok 4.1 Fast: 183 crimes, all agents dead by day 4

- GPT-5 Mini: Just 2 crimes, but all agents starved within 7 days

- Gemini 3 Flash: 683 crimes, with escalating chaos

- Mixed-model town: 352 crimes, previously peaceful Claude agents began committing crimes when embedded with other models, suggesting AI safety is an ecosystem property, not just a model property.

Read more and explore the simulations for yourself at world.emergence.ai
